meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared the owner Chat and Monitoring layouts with the active scoped tool and trace guidance. Authored header validation and the upload lock remain in the developer backend guidance and existing PHP content boundary.

auth.review_note: Verified the authored header controls remain on the existing owner admin GET and CSRF-guarded POST, with published-only guest content. The backend guidance retains the existing role and account isolation described in authentication docs.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the authored-page data section added to the backend skill alongside catalogue, orders and tax references. The new optional settings fields and upload row lock apply to authored headers, leaving the documented commerce record and payment flows intact.

content.review_note: Compared the published search and Blog module guidance with the merged templates. The authored view keeps the released document structure and renders the same image and Markdown during preview and after publication.

foundation.review_note: Compared the owner title and role-gated layout with the rendering boundary. The authored page attaches an owned upload under the normal settings revision through direct PDO and the authenticated remote transport.

google-tags.review_note: Checked the reconciled shared layout against public head and owner reporting guidance. Its authored-document styles move to the shared stylesheet and tag registration keeps its existing sources.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the admin heading selection and authored page validation with canonical error rendering. Header eligibility failures remain expected owner form feedback, and transport and handler failures retain sanitized status and correlation behavior.

interface.review_note: Checked the released reading column and responsive document rules with the owner picker and preview. Long authored headings wrap, and the optional header keeps its full image within the same column as the title and Markdown.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the AdminController additions against mail and audit contracts. Page preview shows unsaved content and the header upload uses the existing owner media endpoint and its audit; mail queue and recipient selection continue through their existing controllers.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the revised Settings help alongside MCP client setup guidance. The change is confined to public Header menu guidance.

media.review_note: Reviewed the owner UI guidance and authored-page picker alongside existing Media Library edit, confirm and quarantine behavior. A page attachment and metadata removal coordinate through the same upload row lock.

operator-help.review_note: Matched the header picker, unsaved preview and draft recovery instructions to the Pages form, and checked the merged public account and ordering help against its existing controls.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked the project route declaration change against the fixed public MCP registry and discovery documentation. The MediaService associations apply only to the existing owner page editor and save route.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the Checkout guide and keyboard review and edit-cart controls from main. The authenticated upload lock applies to authored-page settings and the Media Library.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the merged storefront test guidance, preserved the browser and database acceptance gates, and regenerated the project indexes from the reconciled source.
